item.title: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope exceeds expectations by nearly 30%
item.description: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has exceeded expectations after engineers made incredibly tiny adjustments to sharpen its view of the universe. Roman’s Wide Field Instrument now produces image quality nearly 30% better than predicted, promising exceptionally sharp cosmic surveys. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Red-sensitive pigments in mantis shrimp eyes act as reversible light switches
item.description: With about 30 visual pigments, compared to just three in humans, mantis shrimp possess a visual system that remains a mystery. This finding, published in Science Advances, has potential applications in optogenetics. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Kenya has confirmed a third case of Ebola, a relative of a man who died earlier this month after travelling from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The second patient, a 39-year-old man from the same family, is in a stable condition. Health officials say there is no evidence of community transmission, as both individuals were under quarantine.
